name: @aws-sdk/client-comprehend
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Comprehend Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: The README is well-structured for the AWS SDK v3 monorepo but is generic boilerplate not specific to @aws-sdk/client-comprehend, leaving users without any Comprehend-specific guidance.
readme.top_issue: README is entirely about DynamoDB and the general SDK; it contains zero content specific to the Comprehend client — no Comprehend examples, API overview, or relevant use cases.

security.summary: The code appears secure with no major issues found, but input validation should be ensured before using client methods.

common_complaints: Release process issues (topological ordering causing installation failures)
Performance regression in Lambda Node 22 coldstart latency
sentiment.summary: The project shows moderate health with responsive issue closure, but struggles with a year-old Lambda performance regression (12 comments, still pending) and release process problems that can break user installations.

red_flags: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed for complex issues
A few responses assume a certain level of familiarity with the SDK
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful, clear, and patient. They provide technical depth where necessary and encourage new contributors, though some could benefit from additional detail.
